comparison.objective: Prove a medium-voltage detector before and after use as part of an electrical safety check.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and position a detector at the prescribed proving and test points in the correct sequence while maintaining safe handling.
comparison.success_condition: The required prove-test-prove sequence and detector indications must be completed without contacting forbidden energized geometry or omitting a proof step.
comparison.reason: This tests instrument use and safety-critical sequencing rather than mechanical separation. No relevant overlap exists with mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, notch fracture, or tang containment.
